title: Extension to a neighbourhood of one valuation-stalk point
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $X,Y$ be $S$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-over-base]. Suppose that $X$ is integral [def-pc-integral-scheme] and Noetherian, meaning locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact. Let $Y\to S$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], let $U\subseteq X$ be a dense open subscheme [def-weil-open-immersion], and let $f:U\to Y$ be an $S$-morphism. Let $x\in X$ be a point for which $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is a valuation ring [def-trf-valuation-ring]: for every nonzero element $z$ of its fraction field, either $z$ or $z^{-1}$ belongs to $\mathcal O_{X,x}$. There exist an open subscheme $V\subseteq X$ containing $U$ and $x$ and an $S$-morphism $F:V\to Y$ with $F|_U=f$.

source.place: Tag 0BX7 (morphisms-lemma-extend-across), integral Noetherian specialization; the point lies in the closure of U because U is dense. No assumption that all stalks are valuation rings, no field-base hypothesis, and no absolute separatedness hypothesis.

proof.text: By [def-pc-integral-scheme], $X$ is nonempty and irreducible; apply [lem-sc-scheme-sober] to the irreducible closed subset $X$ itself to obtain its unique generic point $\eta$. Put $A=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ and $K=\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$. By [lem-sc-integral-scheme-stalks-in-function-field], $K$ is a field of fractions of $A$ via the specialization homomorphism $\rho_x:A\to K$. Since $X$ is nonempty and $U$ is dense, $U$ is nonempty, and hence $\eta\in U$. Write $c_x:\operatorname{Spec}A\to X$ and $i_\eta:\operatorname{Spec}K\to X$ for the canonical local-scheme morphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-spec-local-ring-canonical-morphism]. Put $j=\operatorname{Spec}(\rho_x):\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}A$. Then $c_x\circ j=i_\eta$: on an affine neighbourhood $\operatorname{Spec}R$ of $x$, both are induced by the germ map $R\to K$, one directly and one through $R\to A\to K$. The generic morphism $i_\eta$ factors through $U$; call this factor $i_U$. Set $h=f\circ i_U$.

source.place: Tag 0BX7, proof, unique generic point and fraction field before the valuative square; canonical maps as in schemes.tex Tag 01J6 (schemes-lemma-morphism-from-spec-local-ring), Equation 02NA

proof.text: Let $a_X:X\to S$ and $a_Y:Y\to S$ be the structure morphisms. The square with top $h:\operatorname{Spec}K\to Y$, left $j$, bottom $a_X\circ c_x$, and right $a_Y$ commutes: $a_Yh=a_Xi_\eta=a_Xc_xj$, because $f$ is over $S$. The ring $A$ is a valuation ring by hypothesis and $K$ is its fraction field by step 1. Apply [lemma-nagata-proper-valuative-criterion-existence-api] to proper $a_Y$. Obtain $t:\operatorname{Spec}A\to Y$ satisfying $t\circ j=h$ and $a_Y\circ t=a_X\circ c_x$. Only existence is needed.

source.place: Tag 0BX7, proof, valuative square, invoking Tag 0BX5 (morphisms-lemma-characterize-proper)

proof.text: Properness of $a_Y$ includes finite type, hence locally finite type, by [def-weil-proper-morphism]. The source $X$ is locally Noetherian by hypothesis. Apply [lem-sfb-local-ring-map-spread] with $T=X$, $Z=Y$, point $x$, and local-scheme map $t$ from step 2. It gives an open neighbourhood $W$ of $x$ and a morphism $g:W\to Y$ such that $a_Yg=a_X|_W$ and $g\circ c_{x,W}=t$, with $c_{x,W}$ the factorization of $c_x$ through $W$. In particular $g$ is an $S$-morphism.

source.place: Tag 0BX7, proof, spreading t by Tag 0BX6 (morphisms-lemma-morphism-defined-local-ring), case (2)(c)

proof.text: Put $D=U\cap W$. It contains $\eta$, since $W$ contains $x$ and is nonempty. Thus $D$ is integral: every nonempty affine open of $D$ is an affine open of $X$ with domain coordinate ring, as in [def-pc-integral-scheme]. In particular $D$ is reduced. Let $i_D:\operatorname{Spec}K\to D$ be the factor of $i_\eta$. Its image is the generic point $\eta$, hence is dense in $D$. On $\operatorname{Spec}K$ the two maps $f|_D,g|_D$ agree: the first composite with $i_D$ is $h$, and the second is $g\circ c_{x,W}\circ j=t\circ j=h$. Here $c_{x,W}j$ is the factor of $i_\eta$ through $W$, by step 1 and uniqueness of factorization through an open immersion. Their composites to $S$ are both $a_X|_D$. Properness makes $a_Y$ separated by [def-weil-proper-morphism], so [lem-sfb-relative-separated-dominant-ext] applied to the reduced source $D$ and dense-image test morphism $i_D$ gives $f|_D=g|_D$. This uses relative separatedness of $Y\to S$.

source.place: Tag 0BX7, proof, final closed-equalizer argument; schemes.tex Tag 01KM (schemes-lemma-where-are-they-equal) in the relative dominant-morphism form

proof.text: Take $V=U\cup W$. By [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing], the equality on $D$ gives a morphism $F:V\to Y$ restricting to $f$ on $U$ and $g$ on $W$. The two morphisms $a_YF$ and $a_X|_V$ agree on both members $U,W$ of this open cover, so the uniqueness clause of the same gluing node gives $a_YF=a_X|_V$. Therefore $F$ is over $S$, $F|_U=f$, and $V$ contains $U$ and $x$, as required.

source.place: Tag 0BX7, proof, final sentence U union W; schemes.tex Tag 01JB (schemes-lemma-glue) and the morphism gluing property

The affine formula of the canonical-morphism node gives c_x∘j = i_η, and its clause (1) factors i_η through U. Step 4: D = U∩W is integral and reduced, Spec K→D has dense image {η}, and both maps compose to h (an open immersion is a monomorphism). The new leaf then uses only the relative separatedness of Y→S. Step 5: gluing existence and uniqueness show F is over S. Edge cases checked: x in U, x = η, an arbitrary non-separated S. lean.statement: theorem exists_extension_at_valuation_stalk (S X Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X] (a : X ⟶ S) (b : Y ⟶ S) [IsProper b] (U : X.Opens) (hU : Dense (U : Set X)) (f : U.toScheme ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ b = U.ι ≫ a) (x : X) [ValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)] : ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hUV : U ≤ V), x ∈ V ∧ ∃ F : V.toScheme ⟶ Y, F ≫ b = V.ι ≫ a ∧ X.homOfLE hUV ≫ F = f
